_comment: long-doc-qa on gemma4-31b. Working set = kv_cache_volume * tokens_per_gb_kvcache / ldqa_document_length = 16*15000/16000 = 15 documents, 3 queries each. ldqa_num_inflight_requests 4 sits well inside --max-num-seqs 16 and inside the KV pool (4*16000 = 64k of ~576k effective tokens). No LMCache: gemma4 runs without --kv-transfer-config (see the header of gemma4-deployment_spark.yaml for why), so lmcache_url is omitted and tokens_per_gb_kvcache is pinned instead of auto-resolved from the MP server. 15000 = the engine's measured effective capacity, 4.40x concurrency at the 131072-token context over a 37.5 GiB pool (4.40*131072/37.5). The raw 'GPU KV cache size: 81,920 tokens' figure understates it because Gemma-4's sliding-window layers only hold a window. AUTH: `model` MUST stay set here. lmcache bench sends OPENAI_API_KEY as a bearer token on /v1/chat/completions (200 OK) but NOT on its /v1/models auto-detect probe, which 401s against the authenticated endpoint. With `model` pinned the probe is never needed; drop it and the run cannot resolve the model name.
